title: On a phone, show that the vitals grid has more columns (Trend) to the right, with an affordance outside the cells
evidence: From PR 1712 (dropped). At 390 the vitals grid opens on the New column and Trend sits off to the right; scrollbars are hidden, so nothing says the grid scrolls. A right-edge fade was tried in PR 1712 and dropped: after H79's whole-column snap it can only land on the New column, so it dimmed a chat value waiting for review. The affordance must sit outside the cells (for example beside or above the grid), never over a value. Design note with a mock first. needs_brad turns yes if the affordance adds words. Related: H105 (clipped sliver), H79 (column snap). (H106)
